capture.title: A local’s walking guide to Rome
capture.description: Quiet streets, timeless landmarks, and neighborhood stops for exploring Rome on foot.
capture.author: Lucia Ferri
paragraphs: Begin before the streets fill, when shutters are lifting and the first coffee cups reach the counters. Rome rewards a slow route more than a strict itinerary.
Cross the river by the oldest bridge you can find, then leave the main road whenever a shaded lane catches your eye.

capture.title: Why old city trees outlive the streets around them
capture.description: A field report on roots, stonework, and the people caring for ancient urban trees.
capture.author: Elena Marin
paragraphs: At the center of the oldest square, the paving bends around a plane tree whose roots began spreading before the surrounding streets carried cars.
Preserving these trees means preserving a living record.
